Formation & Training

How Leaders Are Formed

In our scout tradition, leadership is not a title—it is an act of service (Servir). The vast majority of our chefs began in the group as young Gramiz or Kochefe, taking their promise at the altar of Saint Jean Marc before rising through the ranks.

Before taking responsibility for a unit, each leader undergoes rigorous pedagogical, psychological, and outdoor first-aid training camps, adhering strictly to the national guidelines of the Lebanese Scout Federation.

Groupe Saint Jean Marc فوج القديس يوحنا مرقس

Founded on May 5, 1977. Serving youth through fellowship, outdoor woodcraft, personal character, and civic service at Saint Jean Marc, Byblos. تأسس الفوج في ٥ أيار ١٩٧٧. تنشئة أجيال على روح الأخوة، مهارات الخلاء، بناء الشخصية، وخدمة المجتمع في رعية مار يوحنا مرقس، جبيل.
